high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "sarathcastic," who posted it 11 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a quote from another user, "the.notorious.pig." The quote reads: "When you are happy that it's finally Sunday but it finally kicks in that the idea of a Sunday only excites you because you can enjoy the Saturday without any guilt knowing a whole Sunday is left, and when Sunday eventually arrives you're filled with nothing but guilt of an approaching Monday.
